compatibility: Legacy Recording preserves dataset_pilot config paths; Pairs is a direct re-export. Data/command schemas and thresholds unchanged.

before_after_parity.includes: CLI arguments, publishers, witness/ready, events/labels, SIGINT/TERM/timeouts, raw float32/endian/padding/dedup and index bytes

limits: Synthetic ROS probes use fabricated payloads and isolated domains; Gazebo cases use real camera/robot data.
Warmup auxiliary frames absent from MCAP are reported and excluded from bitwise matched counts.
No dataset append, model training, held-out evaluation or controller tuning. Old freezes require recorded checkouts, not rewritten hashes.
next_work: Retire obsolete cohort/driver orchestration and consolidate the remaining audit/export entrypoints.
